line: ASUS Zenbook S14 OLED (2026, UX5406AA, Intel Panther Lake)
config_name: Zenbook S14 — Core Ultra 7 355 (Panther Lake), 16GB, 512GB SSD, 14" 3K OLED 120Hz touch

specs.keyboard_notes: Shallow travel but types well per UBR; oversized glass touchpad

battery.notes: 77Wh (up from 72Wh). UBR: ~12-14h text editing, 13-15h video at Whisper mode 120 nits; 7-10h browsing Standard mode.

offers.name: ASUS Zenbook S14 14" Touchscreen AI PC Laptop - Scandinavian White (Intel Core Ultra 7 355/16GB RAM/512GB SSD/Win11)
ASUS Zenbook S14 14" 3K OLED 120Hz Touchscreen Copilot+ PC Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 7 355 - 16GB - 1TB SSD - Windows 11 Home

reviews.quote: this refreshed Asus Zenbook S14 refines the existing series in a few ways: it implements faster Panther Lake hardware, a brighter OLED display, updated cooling that allows for lower thermals... this is the best-made and best-feeling Zenbook to date, and one of the nicest premium ultrabooks out there.
Too bad it's functionally compromised by its ultra-thin chassis design

praises: Gorgeous bright 3K 120Hz OLED touch panel — big step over the standard Zenbook 14's 2K
77Wh in a ~1.15 kg ultra-thin chassis; runtime is excellent for the weight
Premium Ceraluminum build feels better than any previous Zenbook
Thunderbolt 4 x2 + USB-A + HDMI is a generous port list at this thickness
complaints: Runs noisy under load — cooling limited by the ultra-thin profile (UBR THE BAD)
Grainy subpixel structure on the OLED visible up close
16GB RAM ceiling on this tier; Ultra 9 386H configs scarce in Canada

design_philosophy: ASUS's highest-tier consumer thin-and-light: ultra-thin Ceraluminum premium chassis, best OLED panel in the family, maximum portability over sustained performance. The 2026 Panther Lake refresh adds ~50% CPU uplift and a brighter panel while keeping the ultra-slim compromises (fan noise, shallow keys, 145° hinge).
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from Ultrabookreview's UX5406AA review (Ultra 9 386H config, 4.25/5, US$1,649): this Ultra 7 355 tier gets −0.5 productivity/ai_ml vs the reviewed Ultra 9; UBR notes Ultra 7 355 is the weaker Panther Lake option. BBY customer rating 4.0 (2 reviews).
